rows.target_text: ひどかったって言ってた

rows.known_text: said that that would be helpful
rows.target_text: それ助かるって言ってた

rows.known_text: said that that idea was truly good
rows.target_text: そのアイデアは本当に良かったって言ってた

rows.known_text: because you said that you were going to be late
rows.target_text: 遅れそうって言ってたから

rows.known_text: my daughter said that she has to leave in a few days
rows.target_text: 娘数日で出ないといけないって言ってた

rows.known_text: my son said that he won't be able to go next month
rows.target_text: 息子来月行けないって言ってた

rows.known_text: i didn't want to ask because you said that you were busy
rows.target_text: 忙しかったって言ってたから聞きたくなかった

rows.known_text: i think you said that it was great
rows.target_text: 最高って言ってたと思う

rows.known_text: i'm not sure if you said that you want to work together
rows.target_text: 一緒に働きたいって言ってたかどうか分からない

rows.known_text: i'll ask if they said that they can stay longer
rows.target_text: もっと長くいられるって言ってたか聞いてみる

rows.known_text: last night you said that you had nothing left to say anymore
rows.target_text: 昨夜もう言うことがないって言ってた
